lifecycleEvidence.snapshot: # Vaults Panoptic vaults span the risk-return spectrum, offering strategies for both conservative depositors and higher-risk yield seekers. Vaults may be curated by Panoptic or by external managers. Panoptic Community Vaults provide onchain yield with zero performance fees. External curators may deploy custom strategies and charge performance fees. ## Community Vaults Panoptic’s community vaults do not charge performance fees and are designed to provide accessible, onchain yield strategies. New vaults and expanded caps will roll out every few weeks after launch. Panoptic will initially launch with two community vaults. ![Panoptic vaults comparison](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/panoptic-vaults-comparison-f5b121ec1f00833e530556bec7aa2a55.png) ### USDC Unicorn Vault Deposited USDC is allocated into Panoptic’s underlying lending markets, beginning with the ETH/USDC market and expanding to additional markets like BTC/USDC over time. The strategy also runs systematic, delta-neutral gamma scalping designed to buy low and sell high. ![USDC Unicorn Vault animation](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/usdc-unicorn-vault-1676f5b572c5481d5091fa8a66c7517b.gif) ![USDC Unicorn Vault details](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/unicorn-vault-info-3ca0a86bdfc498f28002f77862265723.png) ### WETH PLP Vault Deposited WETH is allocated into Panoptic’s underlying lending markets, beginning with the ETH/USDC market at launch. The vault provides liquidity to Panoptic through lending and market making strategies, and accrues platform fees. ![WETH PLP Vault animation](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/weth-plp-vault-a49de4dc91fb3f802b4b8e650f394fed.gif) ![WETH PLP Vault details](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/plp-vault-info-080965f9a5fb0070871972fd6537885e.png) ## Curated Vaults Anyone can create a vault using Panoptic’s vault infrastructure. Curated vaults may run any strategy — including lending or options trading — and may charge performance fees to depositors.

sourceSemantics.asset: WETH 18 decimals; shares have underlying decimals but price differs from asset units. All selected functions nonpayable.
sourceSemantics.requestDeposit: Adds uint128 assets to caller current deposit queue and aggregate; SafeTransferFrom underlying caller -> vault.
sourceSemantics.requestWithdrawal: Caller only; proportionately removes userBasis, enqueues amount+basis, burns virtual shares. Zero user share balance divides by zero; caller must use an owned balance.
sourceSemantics.cancelDeposit: No-arg ordinary function only: zeros current caller deposit queue, decreases aggregate with saturating floor, transfers underlying back to caller; overloaded address form is manager-only.
sourceSemantics.executeDeposit: Permissionless fixed user/epoch execution after epoch < depositEpoch. Floor pro-rata fulfilled assets then floor shares, mint virtual user balance and add basis; remainder rolls epoch+1. Manager already added minted supply at fulfillment.
sourceSemantics.executeWithdrawal: Permissionless fixed user/epoch execution after epoch < withdrawalEpoch. Floor pro-rata fulfilled shares/assets/basis; reserve accounting and performance fee on positive profit, then send underlying to user or queue current deposit if manager redeposit flag persisted; leftover rolls epoch+1.
sourceSemantics.optOutOfRedeposit: Only msg.sender withdrawal queue flag for selected epoch set false; no arbitrary target call.
sourceSemantics.fulfillment: Manager-only excluded fulfillment uses owner-replaceable accountant.computeNAV plus 1 asset, less queued deposits and withdrawal reserves. Initial virtual supply 1,000,000; Math.mulDiv floors. No user min-return guard.
sourceSemantics.authority: Owner controls manager/accountant/fee wallet. Manager may call arbitrary targets with vault assets and trigger requestWithdrawalFrom for any user/redeposit. No claim that source-level privilege implies financial safety.
sourceSemantics.fee: Performance fee immutable-after-initialize in this ABI, 0 in creation and explorer read; generic source charges max(assets-basis,0)*bps/10000 to fee wallet on withdrawal.
sourceSemantics.eligibility: No selected source modifier implements allowlist/KYC/pause; source inventory does not override legal/frontend eligibility.

limitations: Only the Ethereum WETH PLP immutable clone is admitted; no retired close-only market, RiskEngine, pool dispatch, trading, vault management, callback or multicall is admitted.
